list.writePermission: Creating and editing a watch needs <permission>property_watch:write</permission>.
list.emptyBody: A property watch counts the values of one or two properties, such as a username, over a log source, a log source type or a group, in 5-minute buckets. It learns what is normal for each value and reports a value that appears, disappears or changes. Until one exists there is nothing to judge here.

writeNotice.body: Creating, editing, enabling and deleting property watches needs <permission>property_watch:write</permission>. An admin or the <role>detection_engineer</role> role can grant it.

meaning.NEVER_RUN: No bucket has been collected for this watch yet. A watch that has not run is not judged.
meaning.NOT_ENABLED: The property-watch collection switch is off, so no search is sent.
meaning.DISABLED: This watch is switched off. Its history and incidents are kept.
meaning.SCOPE_EMPTY: The scope resolves to no synced log source, so no bucket is collected.
meaning.SCOPE_STALE: The synced inventory of the scope is older than the staleness limit, so no bucket is collected and open incidents hold.
meaning.SCOPE_TOO_LARGE: The scope needs more searches per run than one watch may use, so no bucket is collected.
meaning.NOT_APPLICABLE: The property parsed on no event in scope. The values are not measured and no verdict is given.
meaning.STALE: No bucket has been stored for longer than the cadence allows.
meaning.READING_HISTORY: Reading history from QRadar. Nothing is judged until it finishes.
meaning.OPEN: An incident is open on one of its values.
meaning.RECOVERING: An incident is recovering and is held open until it is confirmed.
meaning.OK: The last collected bucket was judged.

history.readingReason: {progress} read. Nothing is judged until it finishes.

state.READING: Reading history from QRadar: {progress}. Nothing is judged until it finishes.
state.COMPLETE: History: {days} days read from QRadar on {finished}, used for baselines and new-value checks. Those buckets were not judged.
state.PARTIAL_FLOOR: History: {progress}. QRadar holds events of this scope from {floor}; earlier buckets are not claimed as zero.
state.PARTIAL_FALLBACK: The requested history could not be read in full.
state.UNAVAILABLE: QRadar holds no events of this scope in the last {requested} days. The watch learns forward.

format.latencyCaveat: This is not a seconds-level correlation engine — for alerting within seconds, use QRadar's own rules.
format.latencyKnownLead: Watches are judged on collected 5-minute buckets, {delay} after the events arrive (the schedule is set on
format.latencyUnknownLead: Watches are judged on collected 5-minute buckets, after each collection of their family (the schedule is set on
format.pinAfterDelay: after the next property-watch collection, which runs {delay} after the events arrive

readingMeaning.COUNT: Events counted for this value in the bucket.
readingMeaning.MEASURED_ZERO: Measured: the bucket was collected in full and this value had no events.
readingMeaning.UNKNOWN: The bucket was a lower bound and this value was absent from it: not a zero, unknown.
readingMeaning.NOT_AN_OBSERVATION: This value was not tracked at that bucket, so there is no observation.
readingMeaning.NO_BUCKET: No bucket was collected, so there is no observation.

validation.normalizedNotAllowed: The normalized field is not in the property-watch allowlist.
validation.propertyPattern: Use 1–64 letters, digits, underscores, spaces or hyphens; begin with a letter, digit or underscore.
validation.pinRequired: Enter a value or remove this row.
validation.pinLength: A pinned value is at most {max} characters.
validation.pinCharacters: Quotes, backslashes, control characters and leading or trailing whitespace cannot be pinned.
validation.nameLength: Name must be 80 characters or fewer.
validation.descriptionLength: Description must be 2,000 characters or fewer.
validation.propertyCount: Choose one or two properties; the configured limit is {max}.
validation.duplicateProperty: A watch cannot name the same property twice.
validation.pinCount: A watch pins at most {max} values.
validation.pinParts: Pinned value {index} needs one entry per property.
validation.combinationProperties: New-combination detection needs exactly two properties.

authoring.summary: Tracks {properties} on {scope}{count}, counted on collected 5-minute buckets;{history} {pins, plural, one {# value} other {# values}} always counted; {detection} detection on.
authoring.notInCatalog: Not in the catalog; the preview will show whether it parses.
authoring.definedTypes: Defined on {defined} of {total} types in this scope.
authoring.saveFailed: The property watch could not be saved. Try again.
authoring.dependencyFallback: A custom rule pins this watch.
authoring.saveBackendFailed: The property watch could not be saved. Check the backend, then try again.
authoring.writeForbidden: This action needs property_watch:write. Ask an admin to grant a role that includes it. Nothing was changed.

PW_VALUE_SPIKE.claim: A value rose above its seasonal expected range.
PW_VALUE_SPIKE.learning: Needs a week of reliable baselines.

PW_VALUE_DROP.claim: A value's exact count fell below its seasonal expected range.
PW_VALUE_DROP.learning: Needs a week of reliable baselines and adequate parsing coverage.

PW_VALUE_DISAPPEARED.claim: A normally present value had a measured zero for several buckets.
PW_VALUE_DISAPPEARED.learning: Needs a week of reliable baselines and exact zeros.

PW_NEW_VALUE.claim: A material value absent from verified history appeared.
PW_NEW_VALUE.learning: Needs 7 days of complete novelty history.

PW_NEW_COMBINATION.claim: A pair of values, each seen before, appeared together for the first time.
PW_NEW_COMBINATION.learning: Needs two properties and 7 days of complete component history.

pickers.loadFailed: Scope options could not be loaded. Check the backend, then search again.
pickers.oversizeTitle: Disabled: these scopes are over the per-watch search limit.
pickers.splitScope: Split the scope or use a type scope.
pickers.notSelectable: Not selectable: the name cannot be used safely in a stored property reference
pickers.noCatalogMatch: No catalog entry matches. The typed name can still be saved after validation; the preview will show whether it parses.

valuesTable.label: Tracked values
valuesTable.captionStart: Tracked values, pinned first. The latest bucket is

incidents.failedTitle: This watch's incidents could not be loaded.
incidents.failedBody: The rest of the page is unaffected, but an empty list here would mean nothing: reload the page to try again. Nothing was changed.
incidents.emptyTitle: No incident was detected on this watch in the last {days} days.
incidents.emptyBody: Values that are still learning, and buckets that were lower bounds or not collected, are not judged, so an empty list is not a statement that every value is normal.
incidents.introLimited: Incidents detected in the last {days} days, newest first, in UTC. {shown} of {total} are listed here; the rest are in <link>Anomalies</link>.
incidents.introAll: Incidents detected in the last {days} days, newest first, in UTC. They are also in <link>Anomalies</link>.

thresholdRules.failedTitle: The threshold rules of this watch could not be loaded.
thresholdRules.failedBody: The watch read did not carry them. Reload the page to try again; rules are listed on <link>Custom rules</link> meanwhile.
thresholdRules.unknownPermission: Your permissions could not be read, so the create link is not shown. Adding a rule needs {permission}.
thresholdRules.permission: Adding a rule needs {permission}. Ask an admin to grant a role that includes it.
thresholdRules.intro: A threshold rule is a custom rule that pins one value of this watch. A rule's breaches are triaged on <link>Alerts</link>.
thresholdRules.emptyTitle: No rule pins a value of this watch.
thresholdRules.emptyBody: Pick the property-watch value as the subject of a new custom rule to alert on one value's count.

workspace.seriesFailedTitle: The series of the selected values could not be loaded.
workspace.seriesFailedBody: The values already drawn stay on screen. The backend may be unreachable; try again, or change the selection. Nothing was changed.
workspace.seriesLoading: Loading the series of {count, plural, one {# selected value} other {# selected values}}…
workspace.emptyChartNoBucket: No bucket has been collected for this watch in this window. This is an absence of collection, not an observation of zero events.
workspace.emptyChartNoValues: No value is tracked, so there is nothing to plot.
workspace.emptyChartSelect: Select up to five values in the table to plot them. The default is the pinned values, then the most frequent in the latest bucket.
workspace.remainder: In the latest bucket, {unparsed} of {total} events in scope carried no {complete}{property}{bound}. They are counted here, not as a value, and never as a zero.
workspace.lowerBound: (at most, the bucket is a lower bound)
workspace.valuesFailedTitle: The tracked values could not be loaded.
workspace.valuesFailedBody: The chart and the table need them. Reload the page to try again. Nothing was changed.
workspace.valuesEmptyTitle: No value is tracked for this watch in this window.
workspace.valuesEmptyBody: A value appears once a collected bucket admits it. Until then nothing is judged, and this is not a statement that the property takes no values.
workspace.plotted: {selected} of at most {max} values plotted. Counts are events per 5-minute bucket.

honesty.groupLabel: What is not known about this window
honesty.historyGap: Buckets from {start} to {end} could not be read{reason}
honesty.historyUnreadable: Stored history progress could not be read, so no progress figure is shown. This is not zero days read.
honesty.collectionOff: PW_COLLECTION_ENABLED is false, so no search is sent for any watch. The buckets below are what was collected before it was switched off.
honesty.notLoaded: The stored buckets could not be loaded, so collection health for this window is not shown. Reload the page to try again.
honesty.noneCollected: No bucket was collected in the last {hours} h. The chart is empty because nothing was measured, not because nothing happened.
honesty.missing: {missing} of {total} five-minute {intervals} in this window {verb} not collected. They are gaps, not zero events.
honesty.lower: {lower} of {collected} collected {buckets} in this window {verb} lower bounds; absent values in {pronoun} are unknown, not zero.
honesty.partial: {partial} of {collected} collected {buckets} had no complete count of the scope's events, so their parsed share is not known.
honesty.admission: {count} {values} refused admission at {time}: the watch already tracks its maximum. They are counted in the bucket, not plotted.
honesty.membership: The scope's membership changed at {time}{counts}. Buckets inside the grace window after a change are insufficient data, not normal.

aql.windowUnrecorded: a window that was not recorded
aql.lastEmpty: No bucket collected yet, so no query text has been recorded.
aql.versionChanged: ; the watch has since changed to version {version}
aql.lastQueriesEmpty: No query text was recorded for that bucket. A search that was not sent leaves none.

actions.enableQuestion: Enable this watch? The family switch is {switch}.
actions.capacity: {enabled} of {maxEnabled} enabled-watch slots and {used} of {budget} searches per tick are already claimed.
actions.capacityUnknown: The enabled-watch cap and search budget could not be read.
actions.enableStored: Enabling stores the choice, but no bucket is collected while <setting>PW_COLLECTION_ENABLED</setting> is false.
actions.deleteQuestion: Delete {name}? This removes its aggregate values, baselines and incident history. A custom rule that pins one of its values will refuse the deletion and name every rule to detach first.
actions.withoutHistoryBody: Enable without history to start collecting at the next cadence slot. The watch then learns forward only; QRadar's past is not read.
actions.version: This watch was changed by {operator} at {version}. Reload it before trying again.
actions.enableFailed: The watch could not be enabled. Reload it and try again.
actions.disableFailed: The watch could not be disabled. Reload it and try again.
actions.withoutHistoryFailed: The watch could not be enabled without history. Reload it and try again.
actions.historyFailed: History could not be requested. Reload the watch and try again.
actions.deleteFailed: The watch could not be deleted. Reload it and try again.

definition.versionNote: a new scope or property set starts a new version; values of another version are never compared
definition.cadenceBody: Every {duration} (the PROPERTY_WATCH family's setting in <link>Search cadence</link>); buckets are five minutes wide.
definition.shadow: Shadow: incidents are recorded and nothing pages.
definition.membershipBasisBody: The membership of a group is today's, not as it was.
definition.capsBody: A value beyond a cap is counted in its bucket and never plotted or judged. The coverage floor is {floor}: below it, verdicts that read an absence as evidence are insufficient data.
definition.capsFailed: The cardinality caps could not be read, so they are not shown. Reload the page to try again.
definition.membershipFailed: The scope's membership could not be loaded, so it is not shown. Reload the page to try again.
definition.membershipWarning: What the inventory holds is shown; no count is drawn from nothing.
definition.noChanges: No membership change is stored for this watch.

editor.saved: The watch was saved disabled and the stored definition was previewed.
editor.rate: The preview is rate limited to {limit}. Try again in {retry}. The watch was saved disabled and the preview did not run.
editor.historyLocked: {history}. The request cannot change after history or collected buckets exist.
editor.historyOff: History reading is switched off on this server.
editor.historyServerLimit: History needs {need} searches per tick for this watch; this server gives a history reading at most {available} (PW_BOOTSTRAP_SEARCHES_PER_TICK).
editor.historyFree: History needs {need} free searches per tick for this watch; {free} {verb} free.
editor.enabledWarning: This watch is enabled. Saving here disables it until you enable it again from the actions above.
editor.name: Watch name
editor.walkAfterSave: The exact descendant walk is available after the required disabled save.
editor.propertiesHelp: Choose one or two properties. Two is the limit because each additional property multiplies the combination space and can prevent a reliable baseline from learning.
editor.propertyFailed: Property options could not be loaded. You may type a valid property name, but the catalog applicability reading is unavailable until this read succeeds.
editor.catalogUnavailableFallback: Typed names remain suggestions until the real preview runs.
editor.noPins: No value is pinned. Automatic values can be pinned later.
editor.pinsHelp: At most {maxPins} values or full pairs may be pinned. Quotes and backslashes cannot be pinned. The most frequent other values are tracked automatically: up to {newValues} new values per 5 minutes and {activeValues} in total.
editor.thresholdHelp: Threshold alerts are {link} on a pinned value. A new pin can be used in a rule {availability}.
editor.readHistoryTitle: Read history from QRadar (used only for learning)
editor.readHistoryBody: Reads QRadar's past once before collection begins.
editor.estimate: Estimate: about {searchMin} to {searchMax} searches, {tickMin} to {tickMax} collection runs. This is an estimate, not a completion promise.
editor.historyLimitParsed: Events whose property was not parsed then are not counted as history.
editor.historyLimitMembership: The membership of a group is today's, not as it was.
editor.historyLimitJudged: Nothing is judged until the reading finishes.
editor.conflict: This watch was changed by {operator} at {version}. Your draft was not written.
editor.previewIntro: Saves this definition disabled, then spends {searches} bounded searches over the last closed hour. Nothing is admitted or alerted.
editor.collectionOffBody: {setting} is false. A preview may still run explicitly, but enabling will not collect buckets until the family switch is on.
editor.collectionOffAfter: is false. A preview may still run explicitly, but enabling will not collect buckets until the family switch is on.
editor.previewEmptyTitle: No preview has run for this draft.
editor.previewEmptyBody: Complete the form, then save it disabled and preview the stored definition. The preview will distinguish no events, no parsing and an unmeasured search.

preview.emptySilence: The scope sent no events in the last closed hour. That is measured silence, so there are no values to list.
preview.emptyNotParsed: Events arrived, but the selected property parsed on none of them. No value was measured.
preview.emptyNotMeasured: The preview measured no bucket. This is not a zero or a healthy result.
preview.emptyNoRows: No value was returned in the measured preview window.
preview.parses: The selected property set parsed on {coverage} events.
preview.notParses: The selected property set parsed on no event although the scope sent events.
preview.cannotDetermine: The preview cannot determine whether the property parses on this scope.
preview.catalogTypes: The catalog consulted {count, plural, one {# type} other {# types}} in this scope. It is a suggestion; this real preview is the applicability check.

investigation.openValue: Open this value on the watch
investigation.retained: This value is no longer stored (retention); the incident is kept. The figures below are the ones recorded when it was detected.
investigation.workingMissing: No detector working was recorded for this incident, so its expected range, threshold and baseline cannot be shown. This is a missing record, not a normal baseline.
investigation.expected: Expected range for this hour of the week
investigation.sampleHour: of this hour of the week
investigation.historyEvidence: The {days} days before {before} were verified: {verified} buckets, of which {history} were read from QRadar history from {floor} and not judged.
investigation.lowerBound: The observed count is a lower bound: at least that many events, so the finding is real and its size is not exact.
investigation.seriesEmpty: No series was stored for this value in this window.
investigation.chartRetention: This value is no longer stored (retention), so its series cannot be read and no chart is drawn. The incident's own figures and lifecycle are kept below.
investigation.chartOld: This incident is older than the {days} days the series read covers, so its chart is not drawn. The incident's own figures and lifecycle are shown.
investigation.chartFailed: The series of this value could not be loaded. The rest of this investigation is unaffected, but the chart is absent rather than empty.
